source_solver: Gurobi 13.0.3 via gurobipy (size-limited pip licence), original notebook code cells run unmodified (only the %pip line dropped) on 2026-10-02
notes: Gurobi status OPTIMAL (gap 0, MIPGap parameter 1e-4); NumVars 294, NumConstrs 118, NumIntVars 5 (all binary), 1136 nonzeros. Optimal fleet 983.35 cars (the notebook prints 983), 2820 rentals a week (86.3% of demand), expansion plan as the notebook reports it: Manchester options 1 and 2 and Plymouth option 1, none at Birmingham (3 of at most 3 options, 44000 a week). Confirmed independently by solving all 14 feasible option combinations as LPs on HiGHS: best 132341.4651, runner-up (Manchester 1 and 2 only) 131725.3688. The objective, the expansion plan, fleet size, rentals, transfer cost, rental contribution and expansion cost are unique at the optimum (min/max with profit held at the optimum); the daily plan has alternative optima. All 118 rows, the 174 objective coefficients, the bounds and the 5 binaries of the PuLP model were compared with the LP file written by the original notebook code and match; the only representational change is that the repair variables of Glasgow (the one depot without workshop or option; upper bound 0, attached to no constraint in the original) also appear in its balance rows, so PuLP counts them and CBC accepts them (feasible set unchanged; 1148 vs 1136 nonzeros). Hard-coded values in the original are derived from the data: repair depots (the original's RD set Manchester, Birmingham, Plymouth) = depots with positive base capacity or an expansion option that adds capacity; fleet-count factors 0.25/0.45 from the rental-length mix; damagedFee 10 = damaged_share 0.1 * damage_excess 100; pctUndamaged = 1 - damaged_share; the five capacity binaries and their two orderings (B2 needs B1, M2 needs M1) are rows of expansion_options keyed by (depot, step) with the ordering implied by the step; the limit of 3 is the parameter max_expansions; the capacity increment 5 per option is the column added_capacity. The unused 0.001 same-depot transfer costs are omitted. Kept from the original, and used at this optimum: damaged transfers out of a repair depot go only to depots without a workshop, which do not receive them (11.46 cars a week leave through Plymouth to Glasgow), and damaged transfers between repair depots are received without leaving the sender (11.46 cars a week appear at Birmingham from Manchester); Plymouth counts as a repair depot although it has no capacity before expansion. With Plymouth's option removed and max_expansions 0 the model gives Car Rental 1's reference optimum 121160.2072 exactly; with all options kept and none allowed it gives 120067.6039.
